_about: Source for the four exhibitions. Edit captions, chapters and colours here, then run: python tools/build_exhibitions.py. That script writes public/catalog.json, every public/<slug>/issue.json and the web-sized images in public/<slug>/img/. Plates are referenced by their id in public/categories.json, so the photographs themselves are never duplicated by hand.

site.title: The Exhibitions
site.note: Portraits, branding and coastal work, hung as exhibitions

exhibitions.blurb: NWPRT on the sand, and a cold bottle three ways.
exhibitions.standfirst: Brand work made where the product actually lives: on the sand, under yellow patio umbrellas, and up close for a cold bottle.
exhibitions.intro: Thirteen photographs in four chapters: apparel, patio hours, the waterline and a cold bottle. Scroll to walk the exhibition. Open any frame to read it.

stories.title: Worn
stories.deck: NWPRT apparel off the rack and on a person. The garment first, then the attitude.

plates.caption: An orange NWPRT shirt, a blue tie-dye hoodie, a burgundy cap and orange sunglasses on a wooden rack by the window.
Sunglasses on, a white NWPRT cap tipped beside a dark doorway.

stories.title: Patio Hours
stories.deck: Yellow umbrellas, orange chairs and a cold lager. The slow half of a beach day.

plates.caption: A blue-and-red NWPRT Lager hat beside a glass of golden beer, under yellow patio umbrellas.
The cap and a golden beer in front of the Charlie's Chili menu, beneath the yellow umbrellas.
Yellow umbrellas and orange chairs line the beachside walk, under palms and a white streetlamp.

stories.title: The Waterline
stories.deck: Lifeguard towers, bodyboards and the pier. The brand placed where the beach actually happens.

plates.caption: A lifeguard climbs a wooden tower under yellow flags, the NWPRT graphic set against a blue sky.
Two kids hold their bodyboards in the breeze beside a lifeguard tower.
One gull spreads its wings beside another above a busy, palm-lined beachfront.
Two kids and their boards meet the surf beside the pier, doubled in the wet sand.
Waves pass beneath the timber pier, the NWPRT Supply Co badge set low in the frame.

stories.title: A Cold Bottle
stories.deck: One classic bottle, three ways: white gloves, an ice bucket on the sand, and caps under droplets.

plates.caption: White-gloved hands present the bottle beside a wine glass in a reflective product composition.
Bottles on ice in a red bucket, a game of beach volleyball in play behind them.
Four red bottle caps on a pale surface beaded with water.

exhibitions.blurb: Hills, tall grass, the shoreline and some very small people.
exhibitions.standfirst: Family portraits made outside: under broad trees, out in the Southern California hills, down at the shoreline and on into the evening.
exhibitions.intro: Twenty-one photographs in five chapters. Scroll to walk the exhibition. Open any frame to read it.

stories.title: Under the Tree
stories.deck: Shade, dappled light and everyone close together.

plates.caption: Two children kiss their mother while she cradles a newborn beneath the tree.
A couple sits together under a broad tree, smiling at one another.
Two parents laugh while holding their young child beneath a leafy tree.
A family of five gathers beneath a tree in a relaxed portrait.
A father holds the baby in the foreground while the rest of the family gathers behind.
A father holds a baby in the foreground while the mother and children gather beneath the tree behind them.

stories.title: In the Hills
stories.deck: Open sky, tall grass and room to move.

plates.caption: A family of four sits together in the Southern California hills.
A father lifts his son high against an open blue sky in the hills.
A father dances with his daughter outdoors while another child watches.
Two sisters hold hands while moving through tall grass.
An older sister wraps her younger sister in a hug, standing together in tall grass.

stories.title: Close
stories.deck: Closer in: a newborn on a shoulder, a laughing child, and two faces in black and white.

plates.caption: A newborn looks toward the camera, resting against their mother's shoulder.
A smiling father cradles his laughing child in a close outdoor portrait.
A close black-and-white portrait of an older woman looking straight into the camera.
A young child looks directly into the camera, close and in black and white.

stories.title: By the Water
stories.deck: Down at the shoreline and under the pier, with two very bright balls.

plates.caption: Two children play with colorful balls along the shoreline under an open sky.
Two siblings smile at each other beneath the pier, holding glowing balls.
Two children stand back to back by the beach, holding pink and blue balls.
Seen from behind, two children hold hands and carry their pink and blue balls toward the ocean.

stories.title: Into the Evening
stories.deck: The light goes soft, then it goes. Silhouettes against a pale sky.

plates.caption: A child in a pink dress balances on one leg, one arm out, beneath a pale evening sky.
A father carries two children while a mother holds the baby, all of them silhouetted against the evening sky.

exhibitions.blurb: Thirty-one people, a warm red backdrop, and the places they work.
exhibitions.standfirst: Professional portraits in the studio and on location: a warm red backdrop, clean light, walls with character, the places people work, and the odd event under neon.
exhibitions.intro: Thirty-one portraits in five chapters. Scroll to walk the exhibition. Open any frame to read it.

A composed portrait in a patterned top and a silver necklace against warm red.

Curly hair, a cream knit shirt and a beaded necklace against warm red.
Long dark hair and a burgundy jacket with black lapels, smiling against the red.

stories.title: Clean Light

plates.caption: A professional faces the camera in a clean portrait against a quiet background.
Glasses, a patterned blouse and a smile against a pale backdrop.
A neutral top and a direct gaze in a clean editorial headshot.

A short beard and a steady look in a crisp close headshot against a clean neutral background.
A creative professional meets the camera in a crisp headshot against a quiet backdrop.

A patterned red blazer against a clean white brick wall.

A gray flat cap and a patterned shirt against pale brick.

stories.deck: Scrubs, tea, a flag and a shop floor. Portraits made where the work happens.

A retail professional smiles at work, the shop visible behind.

stories.title: After Hours
stories.deck: Event portraits under neon. The same care, louder light.

plates.caption: A creative professional smiles in a polished event portrait framed by colorful neon.

A business professional in a green blazer smiles in a polished event portrait.

exhibitions.blurb: Two kids, two bright balls and the timber pier.
exhibitions.standfirst: Coastal photographs made around the pier: two kids, two bright balls and the light under the boards, then one figure alone in the shallows.
exhibitions.intro: Four photographs in two chapters. Scroll to walk the exhibition. Open any frame to read it.

stories.title: Under the Boards
stories.deck: Two kids, a pink ball and a blue one, by the water and under the pier.

plates.caption: Two children in yellow shirts look toward each other beneath the timber pier, holding colored balls.
Two children stand back to back by the beach, holding pink and blue balls.
Seen from behind, they hold hands and carry the balls toward the ocean.

stories.title: Shallows
stories.deck: One figure, ankle-deep, hair in hand.

plates.caption: Seen from behind, a person holds their hair while standing in shallow surf.
